description: Map a gene symbol to its expert-reviewed protein in one species: accession, entry name, protein name, synonyms, length and a short curated function summary. The standard gene-to-protein step for bioinformatics pipelines and coursework (e.g. TP53 to P04637, cellular tumour antigen p53). Source: UniProtKB, UniProt Consortium. Returns the top reviewed match only; species default to human, unreviewed (TrEMBL) entries are not considered. (cost: 1 credit)

organism.description: string, optional, NCBI taxonomy id or common name (human, mouse, rat, ...), default 9606 (human)

symbol.description: string, required, official gene symbol, e.g. TP53, BRCA1, Trp53

name: protein_for_gene
